clauses.label: A
clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party agrees to hold in strict confidence all non-public information disclosed by the other party in connection with this Agreement, and to use such information solely to perform its obligations hereunder. This obligation survives termination of this Agreement for a period of 24 months.

clauses.label: B
clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Quartz Systems is an independent contractor and nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employment relationship between the parties. Quartz Systems is solely responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and employee obligations.

clauses.label: C
clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: All work product created by Quartz Systems specifically for Evergreen Ventures under this Agreement shall be the sole property of Evergreen Ventures upon full payment of the applicable fees. Quartz Systems retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies.

clauses.label: D
clauses.title: Compensation
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, Evergreen Ventures shall pay Quartz Systems fees not to exceed $168,000 per invoice period. All invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt. Amounts unpaid after the due date accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

clauses.label: E
clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Washington, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Washington.

clauses.label: F
clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its exhibits, constitutes the entire agreement between Evergreen Ventures and Quartz Systems with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties.
